claims.statement: Given a valid HAK-014 v1 normalization receipt, HAK-016 deterministically derives cardinality-aware optional-selector coverage states that distinguish full presence, partial presence, true absence, zero applicability, and structural failure under HAKSelectorPathTerminalContextV1.
HAK-016 preserves the historical HAK-014 optional selector status and receipt identity while adding adjacent coverage semantics rather than silently rewriting the source receipt.

Strong HAK-016 validation first requires HAK-014 deterministic input/replay validation against the exact supplied raw bytes, policy, interpreter bytes, artifact references, source reference, and resource kind before accepting the coverage record.

HAK-016 coverage records use the named hak.canonical-json.v1 profile and hak.selector-coverage.v1 digest domain, while an adjacent profile-binding artifact binds each coverage digest to the exact inherited HAK-015 profile Git artifact and raw profile-byte SHA-256; tested validation rejects coherent relabeling/count/source/profile-identity tampering after local redigesting.

required_checks.description: Resolve, checkout, and assert the exact PR head.
Compile the HAK-016 selector coverage and exact profile-binding tooling.
Validate the HAK-016 coverage and profile-binding JSON Schema syntax.
Lint the HAK-016 machine-readable qualification plan.
Lint the HAK-016 HAK-010 precommitted obligation-to-step binding policy.
Run the focused HAK-016 derivation, adversarial, replay-binding, canonical-profile-binding, digest, and schema-parity regressions.

required_negative_cases: raw input substitution accepted by strong join
HAK-015 canonical profile id or HAK-016 digest domain substituted
HAK-015 canonical profile artifact ref or raw profile digest substituted
inherited HAK-015 profile bytes drift from bound raw digest
unknown coverage record field accepted by schema
unknown profile-binding field accepted by schema

independence.claim_interpretation: limited to HAK-016 selector coverage derivation, source preservation, replay binding, and digest/schema semantics; does not establish upstream HAK-014/015 qualification, provider authenticity, semantic truth, or runtime authority
